title: GitLab 员工沟通规范：消息、邮件和会议应该怎么用
topic: GitLab 员工沟通规范：消息、邮件和会议应该怎么用

source.title: GitLab Communication | The GitLab Handbook
source.section: Communication overview and principles (7 paragraphs selected for this lesson)
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 依据 GitLab Handbook 的 Communication 页面。本页面包含大量站点导航和其他条目；学习页只展示与本课对应的 7 段 Communication overview and principles，避免要求学习者通读整本手册。练习聚焦以异步为起点、写下私下沟通结论，并以尊重语气邀请补充。
paragraphs: We’re an all-remote company that allows people to work from almost anywhere in the world. We hire great people across many locations, so it’s important for us to practice clear communication in ways that help us stay connected and work more efficiently.
To accomplish this, we use asynchronous communication as a starting point and stay as open and transparent as we can by communicating through public issues, merge requests, and Slack channels.
We also place an emphasis on ensuring that conclusions of offline conversations are written down.
We communicate respectfully and professionally at all times.
Assume Positive Intent. Always begin with a position of positivity and grace.
Kindness Matters. You are looking at a screen, but you are really talking to a person. If you wouldn’t say it to someone face to face, do not send it to them in a Slack message.

Express Your Thoughts Responsibly and Inclusively. We live in different locations and often have very different perspectives. We want to know your thoughts, opinions, and feelings on things. We also ask you to consider the guidelines around communicating potentially sensitive topics.
translations: 我们是一家完全远程的公司，允许人们在世界几乎所有地方工作。我们在许多地点招聘优秀人才，因此对我们来说，以有助于我们保持联系并更高效工作的方式进行清晰沟通非常重要。
为此，我们使用异步沟通作为起点，并通过公开的issues、merge requests和Slack频道进行沟通，尽可能保持开放和透明。
我们还强调确保线下对话的结论被记录下来。
我们始终尊重且专业地进行沟通。
假设积极意图。始终从积极和得体的立场开始。
善良很重要。你看着屏幕，但实际上是在与一个人交谈。如果你不会面对面地对某人说，就不要在Slack消息中发送给他们。
负责任且包容地表达你的想法。我们生活在不同的地方，常常有着非常不同的观点。我们想知道你对事物的想法、意见和感受。我们也请你考虑围绕沟通可能敏感话题的指导原则。
fullTextParagraphs: We’re an all-remote company that allows people to work from almost anywhere in the world. We hire great people across many locations, so it’s important for us to practice clear communication in ways that help us stay connected and work more efficiently.
To accomplish this, we use asynchronous communication as a starting point and stay as open and transparent as we can by communicating through public issues, merge requests, and Slack channels.
We also place an emphasis on ensuring that conclusions of offline conversations are written down.
We communicate respectfully and professionally at all times.
Assume Positive Intent. Always begin with a position of positivity and grace.
Kindness Matters. You are looking at a screen, but you are really talking to a person. If you wouldn’t say it to someone face to face, do not send it to them in a Slack message.

Express Your Thoughts Responsibly and Inclusively. We live in different locations and often have very different perspectives. We want to know your thoughts, opinions, and feelings on things. We also ask you to consider the guidelines around communicating potentially sensitive topics.

notes.phrase: asynchronous communication as a starting point
notes.explain: 先写出可供不同时区阅读的记录；需要实时讨论时再安排会议。
notes.example: Let’s use an async update as a starting point.

notes.phrase: conclusions of offline conversations are written down
notes.meaning: 把非公开讨论的结论写下来
notes.explain: 重点是让未参加讨论的人也能看到结论和下一步。
notes.example: I wrote down the conclusion from our call in the project issue.

notes.explain: 在信息不完整的远程消息中，不要急于把简短回复理解成敌意。
notes.example: I may be missing context, so I want to check before changing the date.

scenario.title: A decision made in a private call
english: Two teammates agree on a deadline during a private call. The rest of the remote team continues using the old date because the decision was never written down.
Jin posts a short update in the shared project issue: the new date, why it changed, and who owns the next step. She asks teammates to correct anything she missed.
The written record gives colleagues in other time zones the same information without requiring another meeting.
chinese: 两名同事在私下通话中改了截止时间。远程团队其他人仍按旧日期工作，因为决定没有被记录。
Jin 在共享项目记录中写明新日期、变更原因和下一步负责人，并请同事补充遗漏。
这份记录让其他时区的同事无需再开一次会，也能获得相同信息。

firstAttempt.prompt: 测试原定周二完成，但客户反馈还不完整，团队决定把测试改到下周三，由 Nina 先确认缺少哪些反馈。请用英文写明改期及原因，并把决定记录到共享项目记录中。
firstAttempt.sample: We agreed to move testing to next Wednesday because we are still waiting for complete customer feedback. Nina will confirm what is missing, and I’ve recorded the decision in the shared project issue.
firstAttempt.rationale: 异步同步决定时，把新安排、原因、负责人和记录位置写全。

words.example: An asynchronous update reaches colleagues in other time zones.
words.translation: 异步更新能让其他时区同事看到。

words.example: A shared decision log makes the change transparent.
words.translation: 共享决策记录让变更透明。
words.note: 这里强调信息对相关人员可见。

words.example: Please write down the conclusions from the call.
words.note: 和 action items 一起记录更可执行。

words.example: We can disagree respectfully in a public thread.
words.translation: 我们可以在公开讨论中有礼貌地表达分歧。

words.example: Assume positive intent when a reply sounds brief.
words.translation: 回复很简短时先假定对方出于善意。

words.example: Written updates support more inclusive communication.
words.translation: 书面更新有助于让更多人参与沟通。
words.note: 强调未在场者也能获得信息。

structure.original: We also place an emphasis on ensuring that conclusions of offline conversations are written down.
analysis: place an emphasis on ...：说明团队特别重视的做法。
ensuring that ...：强调要确保事情真的发生。
conclusions ... are written down：被动语态聚焦“结论被记录”，而不是谁来记。
structure.transfer: We place an emphasis on ensuring that decisions from private calls are recorded in the project issue.

rewrite.bad: We changed the date in a call. Ask someone if you need to know more.
rewrite.good: We agreed to move testing to next Wednesday because we are still waiting for complete customer feedback. Nina will confirm what is missing, and I’ve recorded the decision in the shared project issue.
rewrite.translation: 我们同意把测试改到下周三，因为还在等待完整的客户反馈。Nina 会确认缺少哪些反馈，我已将决定记录到共享项目 issue 中。
rewrite.pattern: We agreed to [decision]. I’ve recorded [reason/next steps] in [shared place].

cloze.prompt: We agreed to move testing to next Wednesday ___ we are still waiting for customer feedback.

cloze.why: 说明下一步负责人要核实的具体事项。

cloze.prompt: I’ve recorded the decision in the shared project ___.
cloze.why: 说明团队可以在哪里查到决定记录。

dictation.text: We also place an emphasis on ensuring that conclusions of offline conversations are written down.
dictation.why: 听清 ensuring that 后面完整的被动语态。

dictation.text: To accomplish this, we use asynchronous communication as a starting point and stay as open and transparent as we can by communicating through public issues, merge requests, and Slack channels.
dictation.why: 听清 use asynchronous communication as a starting point，并辨认 by communicating 引出的方式。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们同意把测试改到下周三，因为还在等待完整的客户反馈。
translationPractice.answer: We agreed to move testing to next Wednesday because we are still waiting for complete customer feedback.
translationPractice.why: because 引出改期原因；complete customer feedback 说明尚未收齐的是完整客户反馈。

translationPractice.prompt: 我已经在项目 issue 中更新了新日期。
translationPractice.answer: I’ve updated the project issue with the new date.
translationPractice.why: 把新日期更新到团队可见的项目记录

translationPractice.prompt: 请在明天前在那里补充风险或修正意见。
translationPractice.answer: Please add any risks or corrections there by tomorrow.
translationPractice.why: there 指代共享项目 issue，by tomorrow 指明补充风险或更正的截止时间。

choice.prompt: 电话里改了交付日期，哪条更新最适合远程团队？
options: The date changed. Everyone should already know.
We moved delivery to next Tuesday because the customer feedback is incomplete. Nina will confirm what is missing; the reason and next steps are in the shared issue. Please add corrections there.
I discussed this privately, so no written update is needed.
choice.why: 它公开记录变更、原因和下一步，并允许同事核对。

output.prompt: 客户数据测试原定本周五完成，但隐私审核仍未结束。团队同意把测试改到下周一，Oliver 会确认审核状态。请用英文同步改期原因、负责人和项目记录，并请团队在周五前补充风险或更正。
output.sample: Because the privacy review is still open, we agreed to move the customer-data test to next Monday. Oliver will confirm the review status, and I’ve updated the project issue. Please add any remaining risks or corrections there by Friday.
check: 是否写清新的测试日期及改期原因？
是否明确审核状态的负责人？
是否指出共享记录位置并邀请补充风险或更正？
